name: Kalshi exotics by segment (Vol+OI)
query_sql:
WITH exotics AS (
  SELECT
    date AS day,
    report_ticker,
    ticker_name,
    daily_volume,
    open_interest
  FROM kalshi.market_report
  WHERE category = 'Exotics'
),
exotics_segmented AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN report_ticker = 'KXMVECROSSCATEGORY'
      THEN 'Cross-category exotics'
      WHEN report_ticker = 'KXMVECBCHAMPIONSHIP'
      THEN 'BC Championship exotics'
      WHEN report_ticker = 'KXMVEOSCARS'
      THEN 'Oscars exotics'
      ELSE 'Other exotics'
    END AS exotic_segment
  FROM exotics
)
SELECT
  exotic_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT report_ticker) AS distinct_families,
  SUM(daily_volume) AS total_volume,
  SUM(open_interest) AS total_oi
FROM exotics_segmented
GROUP BY exotic_segment
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
